name: Meadow Pages
author: satbirgandhi

sections.description:
Meadow Pages is a landing-page builder for WordPress, not a general page builder. It does one job: fast, good-looking marketing pages — opt-ins, sales pages, webinar registrations, coming-soon screens — built from a fixed set of well-designed sections rather than an open-ended canvas.

Features

  • Unlimited landing pages
  • Hero, Stats Strip, Feature Grid, Testimonial, Countdown, FAQ Accordion, Custom HTML, and Footer sections
  • Standalone page rendering — bypasses your theme’s header/footer entirely for a clean, fast page
  • Real email capture with honeypot spam protection, a Subscribers screen, and CSV export
  • Coming Soon / Maintenance Mode — show one page to every visitor while you build or during planned downtime
  • Starter templates (Newsletter Opt-in, Coming Soon, Blank) so you’re never starting from a truly empty page
  • Drag-and-drop section reordering in the builder
  • Optional “Made with Meadow Pages” credit link in the Footer section — off by default, you choose whether to show it

What this is not

Meadow Pages does not include email marketing platform sync, A/B testing, custom analytics code injection, webhook integrations, or AI-assisted copywriting. If you need those, a paid upgrade is available from within the plugin. Meadow Pages is built for people who just want a solid, unrestricted landing-page builder for the essentials.

Bundled fonts

Meadow Pages includes the Fraunces and Work Sans fonts locally (SIL Open Font License 1.1, license files in assets/fonts/), so landing pages load no fonts from third-party servers.

External services

This plugin includes the Freemius SDK, which handles optional licensing and upgrades. On activation you may be asked to opt in to sharing basic usage data; nothing is sent to Freemius unless you choose to opt in, and the plugin works fully if you skip it. If you opt in, Freemius receives your name, email address, site URL and WordPress/plugin/PHP version details.

This service is provided by Freemius: Terms of Service, Privacy Policy.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the meadow-pages folder to /wp-content/plugins/.
  2. Activate the plugin through the “Plugins” screen in WordPress.
  3. Go to Meadow Pages → Add New to build your first page.
sections.faq:
Do I need to know how to code?

No — sections are edited through form fields (text, toggles, lists), not a visual canvas or code editor.

Where are captured emails stored?

In a dedicated database table, viewable and exportable to CSV under Meadow Pages → Subscribers.

Can I use my own theme’s header and navigation?

No, by design — Meadow Pages renders a standalone document for each page, independent of your active theme, so pages stay fast and free of theme CSS/JS conflicts.

Does this cost anything?

No. The free version described above has no feature caps or artificial limits. An optional paid upgrade adds email-platform sync, A/B testing, custom code injection, webhooks, and AI-assisted copywriting that uses the AI provider connected in WordPress 7.0 or later.
